payload.core_mechanism_summary: After prime sieving, for each candidate prime i, iterate over smaller primes j, and check if i equals j plus the prime immediately preceding j plus 1. Early break when matched.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a nested loop with an early break, which can be seen as a simple form of pruning, though not traditional branch and bound. The highest-score candidate subtype "search_branch_and_bound" is chosen as it is the most applicable among options.
